concerns.text: Task T045 and the Plan's 'Methodological Correction' explicitly replace the spec-mandated 'Piecewise Linear Regression' (FR-005) with 'Logistic Regression' as the primary method. This is a semantic weakening of FR-005 and SC-004, which define the 'tipping point' strictly by the piecewise model's breakpoint. The task list must not silently override the spec's required methodology.

Task T028 defines the pruning interval as a 'configurable parameter' read from config.py. FR-004 and Constitution Principle VII strictly mandate the intervention occur 'after every 10 tasks' to validate the causal link. Making this configurable without enforcing the default of 10 as a hard constraint in the task description risks violating the specific experimental protocol required for reproducibility.

Task T036 generates a baseline log with 'pruning disabled' but fails to explicitly mandate iterating through the *same* library sizes (10, 30, 50, 100) as the pruning run. SC-003 requires measuring performance recovery against a baseline 'for the same library size'. Without this explicit constraint in the task, the deliverable may fail to support the required comparison.

Task T016 handles the 'maximal overlap' edge case by setting a flag and implementing tie-breaking, but omits the spec's explicit requirement (Edge Cases section) to 'report the Retrieval Precision (Jaccard similarity to ground truth) as zero' in this scenario. The task deliverable falls short of the acceptance criterion for this edge case.

Task T015 requires writing checksums to 'data/raw/checksums.json' and updating 'state/artifact_hashes.json'. Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) mandates that artifact hashes be recorded in 'state/projects/PROJ-975-llmxive-follow-up-extending-from-chatbot.yaml'. The task targets a JSON file instead of the mandated YAML state file, violating the constitution.
